describe:
Cycle, in the pink colours.
Keeps:
- period: start: date, starts at today. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- avg is 28 when how many period entries is less than 2, otherwise the average days between period entries rounded.
- last start is the latest start of period.
- nxt is last start plus avg.
Shows:
- a bar with "Cycle" and a button that opens a form to add a period.
- if how many period entries is 0:
  - text: "Log the first day of your last period to get a prediction.".
- otherwise:
  - a card with a big number nxt minus today, labelled "days until the next period on" nxt, with a ring toward avg when there is one.
  - a card titled "Your cycle" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of period, first 6; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: log the start date of each period

describe:
Cheques, in the red colours.
Keeps:
- cheque: shop: text; amount: money; on: date; cleared: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- week sum is the total amount of cheque where cleared is no and on is at least today and on minus today is at most 7.
- month sum is the total amount of cheque where cleared is no and on is at least today and on minus today is at most 30.
Shows:
- a bar with "Cheques" and a button that opens a form to add a cheque.
- a card with a big number week sum, labelled "clearing this week", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card with a big number month sum, labelled "in the next 30 days", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- for each cheque where cleared is no sorted by on:
  - a group; a tap opens the cheque for editing; a swipe removes the cheque, with undo:
    - text: the shop of the cheque.
    - text: the on of the cheque.
    - text: the amount of the cheque.
    - a tick box for the cleared of the cheque.
needs: add a cheque with shop, amount and date

describe:
Command cards, in the teal colours, always in dark mode.
Keeps:
- card: front: text; back: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- got: card: a card. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- cur is entry number i plus 1 of card entries sorted by at.
Remembers while you use it: i, starting at 0; open, starting at no.
Shows:
- a bar with "Command cards" and a button that opens a form to add a card.
- if how many card entries is more than 0:
  - text: the front of the cur.
  - if open:
    - text: the back of the cur.
  - otherwise:
    - a button "Show command"; a tap sets open to yes.
  - a button "Got it"; a tap adds a got with card set to cur, then sets i to the result of i plus 1 leaves over when divided by how many card entries, then sets open to no.
  - a button "Again"; a tap sets i to the result of i plus 1 leaves over when divided by how many card entries, then sets open to no.
  - text: "Got right today:", how many got entries today.
- otherwise:
  - text: "No cards yet. Add the first command you always google.".
needs: add a card with task and command

describe:
Data Packs, in the mint colours.
Works out:
- u1 is p1 divided by g1 when g1 is more than 0, otherwise 0.
- u2 is p2 divided by g2 when g2 is more than 0, otherwise 0.
- u3 is p3 divided by g3 when g3 is more than 0, otherwise 0.
- best is the smaller of u1 and the smaller of u2 and u3.
Remembers while you use it: p1, starting at 0; g1, starting at 5; p2, starting at 0; g2, starting at 20; p3, starting at 0; g3, starting at 50.
Shows:
- a box to fill in p1, labelled "Pack 1 price".
- a box to fill in g1, labelled "GB".
- a box to fill in p2, labelled "Pack 2 price".
- a box to fill in g2, labelled "GB".
- a box to fill in p3, labelled "Pack 3 price".
- a box to fill in g3, labelled "GB".
- if p1 is more than 0 and p2 is more than 0 and p3 is more than 0:
  - a card titled "Price per GB" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
  - text: "Best pack is", the result of 1 minus best divided by the larger of u1 and the larger of u2 and u3 times 100 rounded, "% cheaper than the dearest.".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Type all three prices.".
needs: price and GB of three packs
price per GB of each pack
shows how much cheaper than the dearest

describe:
My Age, in the pink colours.
You can change: "Date of birth": date, starts at today.
Works out:
- yrs is the year of today minus the year of born minus 1 when the month of today times 100 plus the day of the month of today is less than the month of born times 100 plus the day of the month of born, otherwise 0.
- mon since is born moved by yrs times 12 months.
- mths is the year of today times 12 plus the month of today minus the year of mon since times 12 minus the month of mon since minus 1 when the day of the month of today is less than the day of the month of mon since, otherwise 0.
- dys is today minus mon since moved by mths months.
- nextb is born moved by the result of yrs plus 1 times 12 months.
Shows:
- a box to fill in born.
- if born is at least today:
  - text: "Pick a birth date in the past to see your age.".
- otherwise:
  - a card with a big number yrs, labelled "years," mths "months and" dys "days old", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - a card titled "More about you" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
needs: age in years months and days

  - a button "7"; a tap sets buf to buf times 10 plus 7.
  - a button "8"; a tap sets buf to buf times 10 plus 8.
  - a button "9"; a tap sets buf to buf times 10 plus 9.
  - a button "/"; a tap sets acc to result, then sets buf to 0, then sets op to Div.
  - a button "4"; a tap sets buf to buf times 10 plus 4.
  - a button "5"; a tap sets buf to buf times 10 plus 5.
  - a button "6"; a tap sets buf to buf times 10 plus 6.
  - a button "x"; a tap sets acc to result, then sets buf to 0, then sets op to Mul.
  - a button "1"; a tap sets buf to buf times 10 plus 1.
  - a button "2"; a tap sets buf to buf times 10 plus 2.
  - a button "3"; a tap sets buf to buf times 10 plus 3.
  - a button "-"; a tap sets acc to result, then sets buf to 0, then sets op to Sub.
  - a button "C"; a tap sets buf to 0, then sets acc to 0, then sets op to None.
  - a button "0"; a tap sets buf to buf times 10.
  - a button "<"; a tap sets buf to buf divided by 10 rounded down.
  - a button "+"; a tap sets acc to result, then sets buf to 0, then sets op to Add.
- a button "="; a tap sets buf to result, then sets acc to 0, then sets op to None.
